documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone with a significant increase in profitability and operational metrics. The company commissioned its new Alu-Zinc coating line and augmented existing colour-coating capacity, while planning further investments in backward integration through a new cold-rolling mill. Management highlighted strong demand drivers in India's infrastructure, housing, and industrial sectors, alongside a strategic focus on value-added coated steel products and disciplined capital allocation. Manaksia Steels reported financial results for FY 2024-25, including a revenue of H584.18 Crore and an EBITDA of H25.69 Crore, alongside ongoing capacity expansion initiatives. The company is executing two expansion programs totaling H125 Crore, funded through internal accruals, to increase production capacity for Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel lines.

guidance.claim: The second expansion programme for the colour coating manufacturing line is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in FY 2023-24.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales tonnage increased by 15% during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of volumes, the Company’s sales tonnage increased 15%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review which was deployed for capital expenditure and working capital needs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review. This was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

risks_headwinds.claim: A decline in sales growth at both standalone and consolidated levels failed to offset challenges posed by global market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels, has failed to offset the challenges posed by the global market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
